title: Rubric: Reef (Square) Knot Dual-Throw Topology & Anti-Granny Rule

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-01
criteria.description: Step 1: Cross active working end right-over-left and wrap under once to create the foundational half-knot. [source_claim_id: CLM-01]
criteria.observable_indicator: Cross active working end right-over-left and wrap under once to create the foundational half-knot.

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-02
criteria.description: Step 2: The second throw must cross Left-over-Right (the exact reverse of throw 1). Repeating right-over-left produces an unstable Granny Knot. [source_claim_id: CLM-02]
criteria.observable_indicator: The second throw must cross Left-over-Right (the exact reverse of throw 1). Repeating right-over-left produces an unstable Granny Knot.
